storyCards.headline: The Humpty Dance: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Digital Underground's "The Humpty Dance" reached #11 on the Billboard Hot 100. "The Humpty Dance" is a song by the American hip-hop group Digital Underground from their debut album Sex Packets.

Released as the second single from the album in January 1990, it reached No.

The song is sung by Shock G's alter ego, "Humpty Hump", marking the character's second musical appearance; the first was Digital Underground's "Doowutchyalike," a pre-album video-single released in the spring of 1989.

The song peaked at #11 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 23 weeks on the chart.

Chart story — peaked at #11 on the Hot 100.
